file_id: Asish Jana vs Unknown on 6 July, 2022

sentences.text: Asish Jana vs Unknown on 6 July, 2022

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak

In re : An
Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection
with Madhyamgram Police Station Case No. 208 of 2022 dated 28.04.2022 under Sections
272/273/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 56/57/63 of Food Safety And Standards
Act, 2006.
-And-
In the matter of : Asish Jana ... ...Petitioner Mr. Swapan Kr. Mallick, Mr. Tarun Kr. Ghosh, Ms.
Suvasree Ghose, Ms. Sudeshna Das, Advocate ... ...

For the Petitioner Mr. T. D. Nandy, Mr.
Antrikhya Basu, Advocates ... ...
For the State The petition is taken up for consideration subsequent to order dated June 7, 2022.
The order dated June 7, 2022 required the petitioner to report to the Investigating Officer once in a week until further orders.
The report of the Investigating Officer states that the petitioner did not comply with such order.
The chemical examination report states that the Sample Pakage Drinking Water is substandard and unsafe food under the Food and Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food and Safety and Standards Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of the chemical report and in view of the report of the Investigating Officer as against the petitioner of non-compliance of the order dated June 7, 2022, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
